name: slim-hud
description: A slim two-line nerd HUD below the prompt: model, effort, folder, git, context, subscription usage and Pull / Commit / Push buttons

position.title: Position
position.description: Below the prompt (over the hint line) or above it (a collapsible band)

showEffort.title: Effort
showEffort.description: Show the reasoning effort beside the model

showWeekly.title: Weekly usage
showWeekly.description: Show the 7-day limit beside the 5-hour one

showResets.title: Reset times
showResets.description: Show how long until each usage window resets

showCost.title: Session cost
showCost.description: Show what the session has cost so far (USD)

showDuration.title: Session time
showDuration.description: Show how long the session has run

autoSync.title: Auto-sync
autoSync.description: git fetch (and fast-forward when clean) on session start and every 2 minutes
